title: Amazon Already Knows What 2028 Looks Like: CEO Andy Jassy Says the Demand Is 'Striking' as AWS Races to Add Capacity
excerpt: Amazon.com, Inc. CEO Andy Jassy said the company is already seeing “striking” demand for 2028 as it continues expanding AI infrastructure to keep pace with c...
content_html:

Amazon.com, Inc. CEO Andy Jassy said the company is already seeing "striking" demand for 2028 as it continues expanding AI infrastructure to keep pace with customer demand.

AI Demand Already Extends Into 2028

Speaking on the company's second-quarter earnings call Thursday, Jassy said the company expects AI-related capacity constraints to continue beyond next year despite increasing investments in infrastructure.

"Even at that amount, we will still not have enough capacity to meet all the demand we have in 2026," Jassy said.

"I believe this dynamic will also be true in 2027, too. In fact, the demand we already have for 2028 is striking."

Amazon Web Services reported second-quarter revenue of $42.2 billion, up 37% year over year and its fastest growth in 18 quarters.

The outlook also drew a bullish response from technology investor Shay Boloor, who said it reinforced his positive view on AI infrastructure plays Micron Technology Inc., SK hynix Inc. and SanDisk Corp.

$AMZN raised 2026 cash capex to $220B as higher memory costs add ~$20B while capacity still falls short of demand through 2027.

Management called 2028 demand "striking" and said spending only follows visible customer demand.

So freaking bullish for $MU, $SKHY and $SNDK pic.twitter.com/El5kD02Fo9

— Shay Boloor (@StockSavvyShay) July 30, 2026

Enterprise AI Adoption Is Still Early

Jassy attributed the long runway for AI demand to enterprise customers that are only beginning to deploy AI at scale.

"Remember, enterprises are still very early in using inference at scale in their current production applications," he said.

He added that about 85% of global IT spending remains on on-premises infrastructure, which he expects to shift to the cloud over the next 10 to 20 years, creating additional demand for AI infrastructure

Amazon Delivers Another Strong Quarter

Amazon reported second-quarter revenue of $200.61 billion, topping the $196.46 billion consensus estimate, while earnings came in at $5.75 per share, well above analysts' expectations of $1.82 per share, according to Benzinga Pro.

The company raised its projected 2026 cash capital expenditures to about $220 billion from roughly $200 billion.

亚马逊公司首席执行官安迪·贾西 (Andy Jassy) 表示，该公司已经看到 2028 年的“惊人”需求，因为该公司将继续扩展人工智能基础设施以满足客户需求。

人工智能需求已延续至 2028 年

贾西在周四的公司第二季度财报电话会议上表示，尽管基础设施投资不断增加，但公司预计人工智能相关产能限制将持续到明年以后。

Jassy 表示：“即使达到这个数量，我们仍然没有足够的产能来满足 2026 年的所有需求。”

“我相信这种动态在 2027 年也将如此。 事实上，我们对 2028 年的需求已经非常惊人。”

亚马逊网络服务公布第二季度营收为 422 亿美元，同比增长 37%，为 18 个季度以来最快增长。

这一前景也引起了科技投资者 Shay Boloor 的乐观反应，他表示，这强化了他对人工智能基础设施公司美光科技 (Micron Technology Inc.)、SK 海力士 (SK hynix Inc.) 和 SanDisk Corp. 的积极看法。

$AMZN 将 2026 年现金资本支出提高至 $220B，因为更高的内存成本增加了约 $20B，而到 2027 年容量仍达不到需求。管理层称 2028 年需求“惊人”，并表示支出仅遵循可见的客户需求。因此，对 $MU、$SKHY 和 $SNDK pic.twitter.com/El5kD02Fo9 非常看好 - Shay Boloor (@StockSavvyShay) 7 月2026 年 30 日

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

企业采用人工智能仍处于早期阶段

Jassy 将人工智能需求的漫长跑道归因于刚刚开始大规模部署人工智能的企业客户。

“请记住，企业在当前的生产应用程序中大规模使用推理还处于早期阶段，”他说。

他补充说，全球约 85% 的 IT 支出仍然集中在本地基础设施上，他预计这些基础设施将在未来 10 到 20 年内转向云端，从而为人工智能基础设施创造额外需求

亚马逊迎来又一个强劲的季度

Benzinga Pro 的数据显示，亚马逊第二季度营收为 2006.1 亿美元，超过市场普遍预期的 1964.6 亿美元，每股收益为 5.75 美元，远高于分析师预期的每股 1.82 美元。

该公司将 2026 年预计现金资本支出从约 2000 亿美元上调至约 2200 亿美元。
